_comment: Phase-1 benchmark aircraft. Supersonic jet trainer. APPROXIMATE. JSBSim model is Aeromatic-derived (BETA) and has its own yaw SAS in the FCS.
name: t38
description: Northrop T-38 Talon (JSBSim T38), twin-engine supersonic trainer

sources.geometry_inertia: JSBSim 1.3.1 stock model aircraft/T38/T38.xml (metrics, mass_balance) -- an approximate public model (release=BETA)
sources.mass_lb: JSBSim T38 inertia/weight-lbs as loaded (empty 7574 lb + fuel/payload) = 11474 lb
sources.control_derivatives: T38.xml aero functions written per NORMALIZED deflection: Cmde=-0.195, CldaL=+0.0193 and CldaR=-0.0193 (|sum|=0.0386), Cndr=-0.007
sources.control_limits: rough public figures, informational only (per-norm derivatives are used for range derivation); T38.xml elevator-pos-norm range is -1..+0.583
sources.max_thrust_lbf: J85-GE-5.xml milthrust 2050 lbf x 2 engines (afterburner maxthrust 2900 x 2 not used)
sources.speeds_n: approx public T-38A figures: limit ~710 KIAS / ~M1.3, +7.33/-3.0 g; clean stall ~140 KCAS is ROUGH (weight dependent); cruise ~500 KTAS rough
sources.design_point: phase-1 benchmark condition chosen for the altitude-hold task (300 KCAS, 10,000 ft, ~M0.53), not a published cruise point
sources.sim_envelope: min_kcas 180 (shared Phase-1 set, ALIGNMENT.md): ~1.2 x Vs1g (146 KEAS) at the 10,000 ft benchmark, as used by Evolution Runner; n +7.33/-3.0 (T-38 limits, approx)
sources.throttle_max: team decision 2026-10-06: Phase 1 is military power only. JSBSim T38 throttle-pos = 2 x cmd, so cmd 0.5 = MIL and >0.5 = afterburner (FD INTERFACE.md 4c/4d). Trim at the design point uses cmd 0.354
sources.flex_constants: Flight Dynamics final Phase-1 values (INTERFACE.md section 0, 2026-10-06 04:05 PT; flexwing.AIRCRAFT_PROFILES): fixed, not genes; section CG aft of the elastic axis (>= 0.02 chord); tip mass 0. Notional (typical ranges, not manufacturer data). Never passed to FD (FD applies its own copy); kept here for reporting and checked equal to FD's in tests.

_shared: Trim point, envelope (min_kcas, nz), pitch-command clamp, throttle_max and pitch/altitude gain bounds come from phase1_shared.json (see ALIGNMENT.md); the sources below still document them.
